title: Randomized YaRN Improves Length Generalization for Long-Context Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2606.23687v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained on short sequences and then extended to work on longer sequences with additional training. However, such LLMs still struggle to further generalize to very long sequences. We propose Randomized YaRN, a training method that improves length generalization by combining YaRN-based positional extrapolation with randomized positional encoding and a length curriculum. During training on short context data, tokens are assigned YaRN positional encodings sampled from a larger position range, exposing the model to out-of-distribution positional representations even on short-context inputs. We evaluate Randomized YaRN on three challenging long-context reasoning benchmarks, BABILong, Multi-Round Coreference Resolution (MRCR), and LongBench v2. translated_title: 随机化YaRN改进长上下文推理的长度泛化能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）通常在短序列上进行预训练，然后通过额外的训练扩展以处理更长的序列。然而，这类模型仍然难以进一步泛化到非常长的序列。我们提出了随机化YaRN（Randomized YaRN），这是一种通过将基于YaRN的位置外推与随机化位置编码和长度课程学习相结合来改进长度泛化能力的训练方法。在短上下文数据上训练期间，token被赋予从更大位置范围采样得到的YaRN位置编码，使模型即使在短上下文输入上也能接触到分布外的位置表示。我们在三个具有挑战性的长上下文推理基准上评估了随机化YaRN：BABILong、多轮共指消解（MRCR）和LongBench v2。当在短上下文数据上训练时，随机化YaRN在16K到128K的上下文长度上一致地提升了推理性能，并优于
tldr: 随机化YaRN通过将YaRN位置外推与随机化位置编码和长度课程学习相结合，使模型在仅使用短上下文数据训练的情况下，也能在16K到128K的长上下文推理任务上实现一致的泛化性能提升。
en_tdlr: Randomized YaRN improves length generalization by combining YaRN-based positional extrapolation with randomized positional encoding and a length curriculum, enabling models trained only on short-context data to consistently improve reasoning performance on contexts from 16K to 128K.
